title: Lantern Cove
summary: A calm fishing evening on the vista engine: walk an island pier at sunset with friends, land four kinds of fish. WebGPU only, desktop.

closed.why: the vista engine is not open to pitches yet (WebGPU only, on a desktop graphics card; about 62 MB a game)

verified.result: PASS 17/17 with --release (14 more checks are 'not yet for vista', each with its reason in verdict.json, never counted as passed); PASS 17/17 with --quick in the smoke test, whose two pages each drew the other
verified.how: npx gamesfun create <dir> --from lantern-cove, npx gamesfun verify <dir> --release (229 s on this branch, 226 s on agent/vista), by hand on Linux with an RTX 5090 (WebGPU through Vulkan in chrome-headless-shell; CHROME_ARGS="--use-gl=angle --use-angle=gl-egl"); the core's own MIT clouds (no sky-pro files in the game).
